title: Do these 4 every day this week, after the kids are in bed
caption: Quiet workout after the kids are in bed: four moves, ten minutes, no jumping. Glute Bridge March, Wall Push-Up, Air Squat and Lying Heel Tap, three rounds, nothing anyone down the hall will hear. Save this for tonight.

overlays.text: Do these 4 every day this week, after the kids are in bed.

scenes.footer: Hinge. On the rug, not a sound.

overlays.text: Glute Bridge March. 10 reps. Push your hips up, then lift one foot at a time.

scenes.footer: Push. Any wall away from the bedroom door.

overlays.text: Wall Push-Up. 10 reps. Hands on the wall, lower slowly, press yourself away.

scenes.footer: Squat. Bare feet, slow on the way down.

overlays.text: Air Squat. 10 reps. Feet hip width, sit back and down, stand up slowly.

scenes.footer: Core. Back on the floor, lights low.

overlays.text: Lying Heel Tap. 10 reps. On your back, knees up, tap one heel down at a time.

scenes.footer: Push, squat, hinge and core. Pull waits a week.

overlays.text: No pull this week. It comes back next week, with a doorframe.

scenes.footer: Ten minutes is complete. You built it after bedtime.

overlays.text: Three rounds of the four. Ten minutes, and the house stays quiet.
Which one are you starting with tonight?
